_comment: Verifies reaction_diffusion pitfall 1 on scikit-fem 12.0.1 (2026-08-06). One backward-Euler step (dt=1e-4, 16x16 ElementQuad1, 289 DOFs) with a quadrature-consistent residual/Jacobian pair. All four blocks: ||R|| = 5.12e2 3.93e-1 2.73e-5 4.19e-13, ratios 6.9e-5 -> 1.5e-8, 3.7 decades gained in 2 updates = quadratic. bmat([[J_uu, None], [None, J_vv]]) with the two off-diagonal asm calls dropped: 11 updates, ratios stuck in [4.2e-2, 2.5e-1], 0 decades gained = linear. Also pins the off-diagonal blocks exactly: at (u_ss, v_ss) = (1.0, 0.9), df_u/dv = u_ss^2 = 1 and df_v/du = -1.8, so asm(jac_uv) equals the plain mass matrix and asm(jac_vu) equals -1.8*M, both to 1e-16.
